name: maestro-ai
description: A team of subagents for software development: research, implementation, testing, review and model escalation by complexity.

saveAndClear.title: Save context and clear
saveAndClear.description: Show the Save context and clear button and the clear_conversation tool (Claude Code only). Turn off to keep only the plugin's hooks, agents and commands.

maestro_mode.title: When to use the maestro-ai agents
maestro_mode.description: complex: only for complex tasks (default). always: for every development task. ask: ask once in each new conversation. manual: only when you ask. Change it later in /config or with /maestro-ai:mode.
